_comment: Meowmind RL CPU bots and the screen's comparison bots (task T0056, docs/MEOWMIND_RL_DEPLOYMENT.md). meow_rl_* sources are generated by bots/meow_rl/export.py; the trained candidates (meow_rl_large_v_s101, meow_rl_small_v_s101, meow_rl_large_v_s101_search) are added here when T0055's final checkpoints are exported. The other sources are existing committed bots, unchanged. Build: python bots/p_only/tools/build.py --variants bots/meow_rl/variants.json

variants.name: meow_rl_warm_start
variants.role: primary control: the reference actor (warm start), sampled actor-direct

variants.name: meow_rl_large_v_s101
variants.role: primary candidate: large-V pilot actor, sampled actor-direct

variants.name: meow_rl_small_v_s101
variants.role: secondary: small-V control actor, sampled actor-direct

variants.name: meow_rl_large_v_s101_search
variants.role: secondary: large-V pilot actor + large critic 2-ply search

variants.name: meowmind
variants.role: secondary: unchanged Meowmind (search, its own V)

variants.name: meowmind_p3_distill_xxl
variants.role: secondary: Meowmind + P3 XXL distilled from the 8XL teacher (T0032 distill_s101), own candidates and opponent expert

variants.name: meowmind_p3_xxl
variants.role: secondary: Meowmind + P3 XXL undistilled (T0011 seed 1), the distillation contrast

variants.name: v12_ponly_xxl
variants.role: secondary: the P2 production P-only bot (v12 carrier, P2 XXL, V off)
